name: American Precision Products
old_description: A leading supplier of custom injection molded products since 1972 American Precision Products can handle your molding program.
about:
American Precision Products was founded in 1972 in Huntsville, Alabama. The company operates as a custom injection molding firm serving commercial, aerospace, and government markets. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The company molds thermoplastics, thermoplastic elastomers, and thermoset materials, including filled and modified resins. Its processes encompass custom injection molding, compression molding, transfer molding, insert molding, overmolding, and miniature and micro molding. Additional services include prototyping, in-house mold building and tooling, and overseas tooling sourcing. Production runs range from low volume to high volume, with micro molding capabilities on dedicated high-speed presses since 1987.

American Precision Products serves military, aerospace, and commercial industries. The firm emphasizes highly controlled manufacturing specifications—tolerances, cosmetics, and production control measures—tailored for aerospace and military applications. Customers include government agencies and commercial OEMs requiring precision molded components.

The company positions its injection molding as faster, more accurate, and more repeatable than traditional compression and transfer molding, offering a path to cost savings and quality improvements for existing programs. Its differentiators include micro molding expertise since 1987, in-house tooling, and the ability to manage both short and long production runs.
